blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police authorities in Western Mindanao on Monday denied releasing cartographic sketches of the suspects in the deadly ambush of Judge Joseph Wee Sit, warning the public against sharing unverified materials circulating online. In separate advisories issued on Nov. 16, both the Police Regional Office 9 (PRO-9) and the Zamboanga City Police Office (ZCPO) refuted claims that official composite illustrations of the perpetrators had been made public. “The Police Regional Office 9 clarifies that it has not released or issued any cartographic sketch pertaining to the suspects in the murder of Hon.
